notes: C6 asks for the Pauli-limit violation ratio, which is already explicitly stated in Methods (factors of 14 and 16) and used by the review in P8, so C6 is marked fixed_in_v1: true. For C7, a second sample is already shown in Extended Data Figs. 9-11, but its inhomogeneity and the broader question of sample-to-sample reproducibility are only partly addressed in v1 and critiqued in P12. For C2 and C3, P16 and P17 target the exact same two-step and non-monotonic dV/dI features under dc bias and demand controls for alternative mechanisms (domain reconfiguration, parallel SC/normal paths, self-heating), though without specifically invoking phase slips.
